title: Can I BEAT 1 Million Chessboards?
summary: iwantcheckmate plays 1 Million Chessboards (a grid of 1,000,000 boards where anyone moves at any time, no turns) with its developer Nolan across three challenges.
rules: Huge grid of standard chessboards; any player may move any piece of their chosen colour at any time - no turns.
Pieces can move between adjacent boards, but cannot capture across boards (transcript 0:53-1:25).
Challenge 1: replace an entire enemy-coloured army on one board with your knights (0:29).
Challenge 2: capture one enemy player's piece while it is being moved (6:26).
Challenge 3: two side-by-side boards; first to capture both kings wins (8:05-8:15).
win_condition: Per challenge; final: capture both kings across two boards first.

board.shape_notes: Grid of many 8x8 boards; pieces travel between boards

setup: Every board starts in standard position.
events: Other random players move pieces at any time
evidence: No frame line. Transcript 0:01 'grid of 1 million chess boards where anyone can make a move at any time'; 0:11 'move between boards and there are no turns'; 0:53 'can't capture across boards'; challenges at 0:29, 6:26, 8:05.
